aboutBody: Bumpling helps you organize your pregnancy — appointments, recommended tests, how you're feeling, and the things on your mind — so nothing important slips through the cracks.

privacyPolicyBody:
This Privacy Policy explains what information Bumpling collects, how it's used, and the choices you have.

Information we collect
When you create an account, we collect your email address and the profile details you choose to add (name, username, phone number). As you use the app, we store the pregnancy, appointment, health check-in, and note information you enter so the app can show it back to you.

Health information
Some of what you enter — symptoms, mood, weight, blood pressure, and similar notes — is health information. We treat it as sensitive: it's stored securely, used only to power the features you see in the app, and never sold.

How we use your information
Your information is used to run the app's features (reminders, your personal timeline, sharing an appointment with a partner if you choose to), to keep your account secure, and to improve Bumpling over time.

Sharing
We don't sell your personal information. It may be shared with service providers who help us run the app (for example, cloud hosting), under agreements that protect your data, or when required by law.

Your rights
You can review, correct, export, or delete your data at any time from the app's Profile screen. Deleting your account permanently removes your data from our systems.

Data retention
We keep your information for as long as your account is active, or as needed to provide the app's features, unless you ask us to delete it sooner.

Changes to this policy
If this policy changes in a material way, we'll let you know in the app before the change takes effect.

Contact us
Questions about this policy can be sent to the support contact listed in the app.
termsOfServiceBody:
These Terms of Service govern your use of Bumpling.

Not medical advice
Bumpling is an organizational tool for your own use. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a substitute for care from a qualified doctor, midwife, or other healthcare provider. Always consult your own care team about your pregnancy and health decisions.

Eligibility
You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use Bumpling.

Your account
You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for the accuracy of the information you enter. You can delete your account at any time from the Profile screen.

Acceptable use
Use Bumpling only for its intended purpose — tracking your own pregnancy information. Don't misuse the app, attempt to access other users' data, or interfere with how it operates.

No warranty
Bumpling is provided "as is." While we aim for the app to work reliably and the content in it to be helpful, we don't guarantee it will be error-free or uninterrupted, and nothing in it should be relied on as medical guidance.

Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, Bumpling isn't liable for decisions made based on information in the app — always verify anything important with your care provider.

Changes to these terms
If these terms change in a material way, we'll let you know in the app before the change takes effect.

Contact us
Questions about these terms can be sent to the support contact listed in the app.
